sections.title: The Core Concept: Change Over Time
lecture_lines: ODEs model how functions change over time.
Algebra solves values; ODEs solve behaviors.
animations: Draw a function graph changing over time, label it #FFFFFF f(t).
Highlight 'Algebra' as fixed values and 'ODE' as behavior, label them #FF8080 Algebra and #80FF80 ODE.
Show a particle tracing a path, change color to #FFFF80 as it curves.

sections.title: Visualizing the Derivative: The Slope Field
lecture_lines: An ODE defines a slope field.
Arrows represent local direction of change.
Particles follow the flow field's trajectory.
animations: Create a grid of points, draw vectors at each point color #A0A0A0.
Animate vectors to align with slopes, label them #80FFFF Slope Arrows.
Trace a particle following the vectors, draw trajectory in #FF80FF.

sections.title: The First-Order ODE: Growth and Decay
lecture_lines: Rate of change equals growth factor.
animations: Graph exponential growth curve in #FF8080 from left to right.

sections.title: Initial Conditions: Pinning Down the Solution
lecture_lines: ODEs define a family of curves.
Initial conditions pin down one solution.
They specify a unique starting point.
animations: Show multiple parallel curves of a family in #A0A0A0.
Place a point at specific coordinate (t0, y0) in #FFFF80.
Highlight the specific curve passing through point in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Summary & Real-World Synthesis
lecture_lines: Model plus initial condition equals prediction.
animations: Flash physical system icon (e.g. pendulum) in #80FFFF.
